## 检查 / Checklist

- [ ] 只解决一个聚焦问题 / One focused problem
- [ ] 已理解并审阅全部改动 / All changes are understood and reviewed
- [ ] 已运行相关测试 / Relevant tests were run
- [ ] 不含密钥、个人信息、内部地址、业务数据或本地绝对路径 / No secrets, personal information, internal addresses, business data, or absolute local paths
- [ ] 第三方内容已注明来源并检查许可证 / Third-party content is attributed and license-checked
- [ ] 已阅读贡献指南和行为准则 / Contribution guide and Code of Conduct were read
